verdict.rationale: Natural language is the product's primary interface. Setup is "a message, not a workflow builder": you describe the job and grant access as the Bot asks. You text Bots from phone or desktop like a teammate, can voice chat live, and can turn walked-through tasks into scheduled skills. A month-long hands-on user says interacting with agents this way "felt natural," and another calls it standard chat plus seamless memory and skill creation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the voice chat mode specifically, since community reports describe chat-based use but not voice.
